about: QA-352 (the tech lead's ruling P-437: every Visitor visa checklist document that offers "Fill this from documents" is read by some reader). The facts a library document type supplies, for the types the library reads as a letter or record (AI vision on Sample files, P-133). Library data keyed by the library's document type, never by a form or program (P-319): the sample loader proposes each set through the library's own route (api/src/document-supplies.ts) as the author and a second person approves it (features/checkpoint/combination/335-document-supplies.ts, the configured checkpoint). The fixture's Visitor visa (acceptance/lib/setup_vv_m3.ts) adds its proof of funds by the author's own add, which the library records as read by a person, so nothing is set there.
basis: Sample (AGENTS rule 4; an ASSUMPTIONS row is proposed to the tech lead on PR #1444). The quotes are IMM 5484 (05-2026)'s own words asking for the document (prototype/p1/inventory/imm5484e.text.inventory.json, visible text in document order, page 1); that the document shows each fact is our reading, not IRCC's words. Unconfirmed: immigration expert. A minor's birth certificate is an identity document (P-134, engine/identity-documents.ts): a person reads it, never AI, so it is not listed.

proof_of_financial_support.reason: Sample (QA-352): proof of financial support shows the money available for the stay, so the funds question can be filled from it.

facts.quote: Proof of Financial Support. You must include proof that you can support yourself and any family members accompanying you while you are in Canada.

marriage_certificate_copy.reason: Sample (QA-352): a marriage certificate shows the date of the marriage, so the union start date can be filled from it.
